title: Cancellations, No-Shows and the Mobile Trip Fee under Repair Estimates & Appointments
content:
**Cancellation.** A customer may cancel a Repair Estimates & Appointments booking at any point while it is booked; cancellation itself carries no charge, except that a customer-pay Mobile Estimate cancelled inside its late-cancellation cutoff hours before the appointment start is a late cancellation that posts the mobile trip fee as an estimate-stage charge.

**No-show.** A booking becomes a no-show when the appointment start plus the estimate type's arrival grace minutes passes without a check-in. For a Photo Estimate, it becomes a no-show when the photo window days pass after the booked date without a usable photo set; a set is usable when it has the required number of photos, and at most the photo resubmission limit of resubmissions are accepted inside the window.

**Missed mobile visit.** A missed customer-pay Mobile Estimate also posts the mobile trip fee.

**Insurance-claim bookings.** Insurance-claim bookings never carry a late-cancellation or no-show charge.

**After a no-show.** A no-show is never reversed into booked; the customer books again, subject to the restriction that follows a customer's no-shows.

### Charge outcomes

| Booking | Event | Mobile trip fee |
|---|---|---|
| Customer-pay Mobile Estimate | Cancelled inside the late-cancellation cutoff | Posts |
| Customer-pay Mobile Estimate | Cancelled before the late-cancellation cutoff | No charge |
| Customer-pay Mobile Estimate | No-show | Posts |
| Insurance-claim Mobile Estimate | Late cancellation or no-show | Never charged |
| Any other estimate type | Cancellation | No charge |

### Timing examples (hypothetical)

- A Mobile Estimate starting Tuesday 09:00 has a 24-hour late-cancellation cutoff: a customer-pay cancellation on Monday at 08:00 (25 hours before) carries no charge; one on Monday at 10:00 (23 hours before) is late and posts the trip fee.
- A Scheduled Estimate starting at 13:00 with a 30-minute arrival grace becomes a no-show once 13:30 passes without a check-in.
- A Photo Estimate booked on a Monday with a 3-day photo window and no usable set by the end of that window becomes a no-show.
